title: The Pearls of Wisdom
notes: Dense letter-level chaining from the pearl merchant through wisdom and the bride, with clean celestial mapping of Proverbs 31 onto the moon and gates, keeps the author's assertive density and law-positive stance. The dual-poem renderings and line-by-line assembly are a strength. Multiple author-prose sentences open with And or That, violating house style and breaking rhythm. One relative clause on the elders' bench is incomplete and obscures the sun-elders link. No quote-text, doctrine, or AI-vocabulary defects; remaining issues are local and surgical.

This chunk assembles the pearl as full moon, throne, east gate, and moedim with high density, Strong's work, and cross-text links while keeping the law-positive calendar thrust. Strengths are the Daniel throne reading, the swine-trampling times identification, and the two-moons contrast drawn from the text itself. Residual defects cluster in presenter staging (Mark, Now ask/hear/set, Mark the last word), author sentences that open with And, one incomplete relative clause, and a light meta close. Surgical replacements restore house style and clarity without touching doctrine, quotes, or symbol claims. Remaining And/That opens and the Grade/Read cues can be cleaned in a follow-up pass if needed.

The chunk’s strength is a tightly attested lexical catalogue that recovers every departure from the King James by the letters themselves, the KJV’s own renderings elsewhere, and the elder Greek and Latin witnesses. Parallel structure in the opening rule sentence breaks on “neither does,” which cannot govern the affirmative “gets a vote.” One recovery sentence opens with And after a period. The closing “Weigh them all” is residual presenter staging. The rest of the list and the final assembly remain dense, law-positive, and free of register slips.

proposals.old: And exactly one phase enters by the east gate at the fall of night: the *full* moon enters in the east at the hour the portrait already fixed — through the front door of the sky's tabernacle, the faithful witness at maximum.
proposals.new: Exactly one phase enters by the east gate at the fall of night: the *full* moon enters in the east at the hour already fixed by the portrait — through the front door of the sky's tabernacle, the faithful witness at maximum.

Now set is a director cue; the imperative alone preserves the author's dense assembly voice.

proposals.old: Mark the last word of that sentence: what the trampling runs until is a matter of *times*.
proposals.new: The last word of that sentence is decisive: what the trampling runs until is a matter of *times*.
proposals.summary: Remove Mark the last word cue.
proposals.rationale: Mark the is forbidden presenter staging; the sentence now asserts the times link directly.

proposals.old: The rule of the link:/books/symbolic-language/what-is-the-point/[What Is the Point?] chapter cuts both ways: the pointing gets a vote, not a veto — and neither does the re-reading, until the letters and the witnesses agree.
proposals.new: The rule of the link:/books/symbolic-language/what-is-the-point/[What Is the Point?] chapter cuts both ways: the pointing gets a vote, not a veto — and so does the re-reading, until the letters and the witnesses agree.
proposals.summary: Corrects mismatched “neither does” after an affirmative verb phrase.
proposals.rationale: “Neither does” requires a negative antecedent; “gets a vote, not a veto” is affirmative, so the parallel must be “and so does.”

proposals.old: the identical phrase is “the *last day*” at Isaiah 30:8. And unpointed, שחק is also _shachaq_ — the witness's sky — a second reading standing in the letters.
proposals.new: the identical phrase is “the *last day*” at Isaiah 30:8. Unpointed, שחק is also _shachaq_ — the witness's sky — a second reading standing in the letters.
proposals.summary: Removes sentence-initial And in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences that open with And; the claim stands cleanly without it.

proposals.old: Weigh them all; the reading asks no favors.
proposals.new: All stand; the reading asks no favors.
proposals.rationale: “Weigh them all” is presenter staging already barred by house style; the assertive replacement keeps the density and the following claim.
